## Summary

Describe the user-facing problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm pack:check`
- [ ] `docker compose --file docker/compose.yaml config --quiet`
- [ ] Relevant Narra/DeepSeek Harness behavior was tested manually, or the reason it was not tested is documented below.

## Compatibility and security

- [ ] Harness version compatibility is unchanged or documented.
- [ ] No setup-guide URL, Gateway token, credential, `.env` file, or private conversation content is included.
- [ ] User-visible changes are documented in the README or changelog where appropriate.

## Manual test evidence

Add the test scenario and sanitized result, or explain why it does not apply.
